en.title: SR 172.010.21 (VILB), Art. 6 para. 1 let. d refers to Art. 57 para. 2 RVOG, repealed since January 1, 2009
en.summary: In all three language versions, Art. 6 para. 1 let. d of the Ordinance on Federal Real Estate Management and Logistics (VILB) refers to Art. 57 para. 2 of the Government and Administration Organisation Act (RVOG). That provision was repealed with effect from January 1, 2009 (AS 2008 5941), the day the VILB entered into force. The reference is already in the original text of the VILB in the Official Compilation; it did not arise when the SR was updated.
en.impact: A reader who follows the reference finds a repealed provision instead of the rule it is meant to point to. No effect on a decision has been established.
en.correction: The office in charge decides whether to replace or remove the reference.

de.title: SR 172.010.21 (VILB), Art. 6 Abs. 1 Bst. d verweist auf Art. 57 Abs. 2 RVOG, aufgehoben seit 1. Januar 2009
de.summary: Art. 6 Abs. 1 Bst. d der VILB verweist in allen drei Sprachfassungen auf Art. 57 Abs. 2 RVOG. Diese Bestimmung wurde mit Wirkung seit 1. Januar 2009 aufgehoben (AS 2008 5941); die VILB ist am selben Tag in Kraft getreten. Der Verweis steht bereits im ursprünglichen Text der VILB in der AS; er ist nicht erst bei der Nachführung der SR entstanden.

fr.title: RS 172.010.21, art. 6, al. 1, let. d : renvoi à l'art. 57, al. 2, LOGA, abrogé depuis le 1er janvier 2009
fr.summary: Dans les trois versions linguistiques, l'art. 6, al. 1, let. d, de l'ordonnance RS 172.010.21 renvoie à l'art. 57, al. 2, LOGA. Cette disposition a été abrogée avec effet au 1er janvier 2009 (RO 2008 5941), jour de l'entrée en vigueur de l'ordonnance. Le renvoi figure déjà dans le texte original publié au RO ; il n'est pas né lors de la mise à jour du RS.

it.title: RS 172.010.21, art. 6 cpv. 1 lett. d: rinvio all'art. 57 cpv. 2 LOGA, abrogato dal 1° gennaio 2009
it.summary: In tutte e tre le versioni linguistiche, l'art. 6 cpv. 1 lett. d dell'ordinanza RS 172.010.21 rinvia all'art. 57 cpv. 2 LOGA. Questa disposizione è stata abrogata con effetto dal 1° gennaio 2009 (RU 2008 5941), giorno dell'entrata in vigore dell'ordinanza. Il rinvio figura già nel testo originale pubblicato nella RU; non è nato con l'aggiornamento della RS.
